<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1373
Claimant:
Connie Peters
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
November 4, 2023
First notice of loss received for a left-turn collision at an intersection. The insured's vehicle was struck while turning,
and the claimant reprots a knee injury from the impact. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact
will go through the attorney's office.
January 26, 2024
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it, with coverage in force on the loss date. Nothing in the
file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
February 7, 2024
Photographs taken at the scene show damage that lines up with the described impact pattern. There are no
independent witnesses beyond the parties involved, so the photos are the main visual record.
February 9, 2024
Police report and statements from responding officers confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the
collision. No prior damage to the vehicle has been identified in the records pulled so far.
February 16, 2024
Claimant's account has been consistent across the recorded call, the written statement, and the follow-up with
counsel present. The described knee injury is plausible for a crash of this type and nothing in the medical history
shows a prior injury to that body area.
April 12, 2024
Treatment records show a usual course of care, with visits tapering as the claimant's knee improved over time. The
billing matches the treatment documented and no unusaul gaps or escalations appear.
April 24, 2024
Reviewed the file as a whole. Vehicle damage, the police record, the photos, and the medical course are consistent
with the reported loss. Claim recommended for standard evaluation of the bodily injury portion with counsel's demand
to follow.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
